notes.title: v1.796
notes.notes:
- Fixed teleport Issue of Ice level.
- Fixed a bug during MP that causes the ball to stop instantly.
- Volume of the change-turn SFX reduced.

notes.title: v1.795
notes.notes:
- Grip to Put feature added on advance options (Now you can disable pressing the Grip to enable the Putter). 
- Haptic feedback added.

notes.title: Update 1.78
notes.notes:
- Fix Server search result.
- Enhance Rocks texture.
- Enhance text rendering.
- Fix penguin animations.

notes.title: Update 1.7
notes.notes:
- Fix the wrong controller angle during the swap.
- Leaderboard optimization.
- Change controller naming inside the options menu.
- Fix the sign visibility of the Ocean level.
